head: 419534ccd4241fc11827741eb0d76ba0c9d21277

source.ref: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/5177; AACR-Bench dataset.json row 412; licence Apache-2.0 read from LICENSE and package.json at head; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; fixed upstream by cb1bda9b5c (#4452, 2025-09-05), which adds a catch to the background commit and binds the hash to the message by ts

rationale: The change stops awaiting the checkpoint commit: it posts checkpoint_created first and attaches the hash in a detached then() with no rejection handler, while CheckpointTracker.commit() rethrows every git failure. unhandled-commit-rejection is required: true at head, introduced by the change, not reported by the repository's lint rules or the compiler, written by a person, and fixed upstream by the checkpoints refactor (author-fix); minSeverity is suggestion since a failing shadow-git commit is uncommon and the extension host only logs the rejection. Its range covers the detached promise chain, where a catch belongs. Base is the merge base (the head's parent). No forbid seeds for this pull request.

expect.concern: The detached commit().then() has no rejection handler although commit() rethrows every git failure, so a failed checkpoint commit becomes an unhandled rejection and leaves the already-posted checkpoint message without a hash, which the diff view cannot use and restore replaces with an earlier checkpoint.
